title: QCLI-555 follow-up: drive the real receipt gate through the tarball route; retry the served-integrity read
description: To Do. From the Opus review of QCLI-555 at 368400ca (findings N1, N2). N1: test/qcli555-provenance-tarball-route.test.ts, the hand-written-bundle case, is refused for a MALFORMED bundle (no version or launcher block), not for an unbound one, and no QCLI-555 test drives the real gate through the route. Drive requireQualification with a stub fetch and the full e2e-receipt.test.ts fixtures to show a pass, a refusal on a different releaseRunId, and a refusal on a different commit. N2: provenance-tarball-route.mjs reads the served integrity once, whereas verifyRegistryHoldsBundle retries six times at 15s intervals. Reuse that retry, or tell the runbook hand step to wait for visibility first. Neither gates 0.15.0 (DEC-251 a5: the operators latest-move script waits for propagation first); both are for the next release.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The real requireQualification is driven through verifyTarballRoute with a stub receipt fetch and full fixtures: a bound bundle passes, a different releaseRunId is refused, a different commit is refused

The served-integrity read in the tarball route retries as verifyRegistryHoldsBundle does, or the runbook hand step tells the operator to wait for visibility first, and a test or the runbook text shows which
